quota.title: Fair use
quota.suspended: Several families reported unwanted calls, so other families' numbers are closed to you until a Mangalya moderator looks into it. Your own clients are not affected.
quota.rule1: Your clients' numbers, and their parents', are always open and never counted.
quota.rule2: Other families' details sit behind the eye. Each new family you open uses one of the day's opens; opening them again within 30 days is free.
quota.rule3: Exports carry only numbers you have opened. Profiles that are not your clients can be exported up to {{limit}} a day.
quota.rule4: Every open and every export is shown to that family. If families report unwanted calls after you opened their number, your eye closes until Mangalya looks into it.
quota.rule5: What you do in your own WhatsApp groups is your business. On Mangalya, families trust us to keep their number safe.
